name: chimera-plugins
description: Curated Claude Code plugin marketplace for the Chimera agent: our own plugins (Apache-2.0) and attributed copies of permissively licensed ones, every source pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review agents specializing in comments, tests, error handling, type design, code quality, and code simplification

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skill for UI/UX implementation

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: mcp-server-dev
plugins.description: Skills for designing and building MCP servers that work seamlessly with Claude — guides you through deployment models (remote HTTP, MCPB, local), tool design patterns, auth, and interactive MCP apps.

plugins.name: customer-support
plugins.description: Triage tickets, draft responses, escalate issues, and build your knowledge base. Research customer context and turn resolved issues into self-service content.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Create content, plan campaigns, and analyze performance across marketing channels. Maintain brand voice consistency, track competitors, and report on what's working.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Write feature specs, plan roadmaps, and synthesize user research faster. Keep stakeholders updated and stay ahead of the competitive landscape.

plugins.name: data-analysis
plugins.description: Write SQL, explore datasets, and generate insights faster. Build visualizations and dashboards, and turn raw data into clear stories for stakeholders.

plugins.name: stripe
plugins.description: Stripe development plugin for Claude

plugins.name: mercadopago
plugins.description: Mercado Pago integration toolkit for Claude Code. One agent routes to four skills: mp-integrate (wizard for Checkout Pro, Checkout API, Bricks, QR Code, Point, Subscriptions, Marketplace, Wallet Connect, Payouts, and SmartApps — plus migration of legacy Instore integrations to the Orders API), mp-webhooks (HMAC-validated receiver scaffold and diagnostics), mp-test-setup (test users, credentials, and test cards), and mp-review (quality and security checks). Scaffolding works offline where possible; live account and documentation operations use the official Mercado Pago MCP server on demand.

plugins.name: resend
plugins.description: Send and receive emails, build with React Email, follow deliverability best practices

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Supabase development skills (Supabase and Postgres best practices) plus Supabase's hosted MCP server for managing projects, SQL, migrations, edge functions and logs.

plugins.name: posthog
plugins.description: PostHog product analytics, feature flags, experiments, error tracking and surveys through PostHog's hosted MCP server, with a skill on how to use it.

plugins.name: thermos
plugins.description: Thermo-nuclear branch review: deep correctness and security audits plus harsh code-quality rubrics, run as two parallel review subagents and synthesized.

plugins.name: cli-for-agent
plugins.description: Patterns for designing CLIs that coding agents can run reliably: non-interactive flags, layered help with examples, pipelines, actionable errors, idempotency, and dry-run.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry Plugin for Claude Code to help with debugging including MCP and skill capabilities.

plugins.name: twilio-developer-kit
plugins.description: Complete set of Twilio skills. Covers Setup, Planner, Product, and Guardrail skills across SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, AI agents, Conversation Orchestrator, and 30+ products.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

plugins.name: whatsapp-cloud
plugins.description: Build on Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API: send text, media, interactive and template messages, receive and verify webhooks, manage templates, and stay inside the 24-hour window, opt-in and LGPD rules. Instructions only — no server, no hooks, no scripts.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server (api.githubcopilot.com). Two servers: a read-only one for repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions, and a read-write one you add only when you want the agent to open issues, comment or edit. Authenticates with a fine-grained personal access token you provide.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server, pinned to an exact npm version: the agent can open pages, click, type, read the accessibility snapshot and take screenshots in a real browser for end-to-end checks of your front-end.

plugins.name: hostinger
plugins.description: Hostinger's official API MCP server, pinned to an exact npm version and narrowed to two scopes: VPS (status, metrics, snapshots, firewall, restarts) and DNS zones. Billing, domain purchase and hosting-order tools are deliberately not included.
